data.name: Gordan
data.gender_notes: Gordan is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'gordianus', meaning 'spear bearer'. This name was given to warriors and soldiers in ancient Rome. The name Gordan carries the meaning “Spear bearer” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gordan usually hope their child will grow to embody spear bearer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Carrier of spiritual weapons and strength.
data.etymology: Gordan belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Spear bearer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gordan total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Gordan offers a historical and military influence, bringing to mind the courage and strength of Roman soldiers and warriors. Today, people with this name are often associated with leadership, determination, and a strong will, reflecting the warrior spirit inherent in its origins.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Gordan also holds deeper symbolism, invoking the image of the knot or problem that must be untied in order to move forward. In the biblical story of Gordium and the Gordian Knot, it takes a great leader to solve the seemingly impossible problem. This name reminds us of the spiritual importance of perseverance, patience, and faith in solving complex problems in our own lives, and trusting in divine intervention when necessary.
